unit.why: A single anecdote about the Ba'al ha-Me'or as a young prodigy who rode a goat and justified it to his elderly students.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי כשהי׳ הבעל המאור ילד רך
stories.summary_en: As a young child teaching elderly scholars in a yeshiva, the Ba'al ha-Me'or rode a goat after study, and when the students protested that he shamed them, he said everyone must have a childhood and better to have it now than at twenty.
